Closed 

The Private Reserve gates access expert only terrain. We strongly recommend that you have knowledge of the area, ride with a buddy, keep your buddy in sight and that both you and your buddy wear an avalanche beacon, carry a shovel and probe and know how to use these tools. You will be riding in avalanche terrain and will encounter cliffs, creeks and waterfalls that may not be marked. Rescue will be extended. As always, only enter through open gates, ride within your ability and know before you go!
Closed for the season

No avalanche hazard reduction will take place anymore.  Ski area is still an active work area. No uphill traffic within the permit area with the exception of designated hiking routes. Thanks for your cooperation.
Thanks for a great season! The Nordic Center is now closed for the 2025-26 Season! We'll ski ya next year!
Thursday, Sept. 17: It sure is feeling like fall with this cooler weather and that means winter is right around the corner! Be ready and get your Season Pass now.

The U.S. Forest Service's Grasshopper Fire Closure Order has been reduced, which means the lands within the Mt. Hood Meadows permit area are once again open to the public. However, many areas east of Highway 35 are still closed. Please visit the USFS website for complete information on the closure area.

We want to give a massive thank-you to all the firefighters who have been working tirelessly, day and night, for weeks, to battle this extremely challenging wildfire. Our thoughts are with them and with the people who have been displaced or impacted by the Grasshopper Fire, as well as other wildfires burning across the West. Please help firefighters, the USFS, and other entities assisting with fire response by respecting evacuation orders, not entering closed areas, and giving them space to do their important work.

We look forward to seeing you all up here when the snow flies!
